'''Control''' was a [[Terreene Brainiac]] model of [[Supervisor droid/Legends|control droid]] tasked with running the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial mining complex|mobile mining operation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alabash]]. It was well-programmed to carry out its task, finding and extracting [[Ore/Legends|ores]] from the surface of a planet. It was also capable of defending itself, but lacked the equipment to do so and instead deployed the various [[Droid/Legends|droids]] under its control to deal with threats.<ref name="Freedom" />
